title: Gold Saver Account: How Automated Sweeps Work with Business Checking
summary: This document explains how automated sweeps work between business checking and savings for a Gold Saver Account. Sweeps are evaluated daily; the system keeps at least $1,000 in checking and transfers any available excess above $1,000 into savings. Sweep activity can be monitored in the account activity view.
